request.description:
Authenticate via Google ID token (sent from the Nuxt frontend after
the user completes the Google consent flow on the client side).

Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists — prevents
user enumeration.

Validates the token and updates the user's password.
Revokes all existing Sanctum tokens on success.

Validates the signed URL, checks the hash, and marks the email as verified.
The `signed` middleware aborts with 403 before this runs if the URL is
invalid or expired.

Return a single brand with SEO, JSON-LD, and its paginated active products.

query.description: Sort order: price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc, newest.
Set to 1 to return only in-stock products.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of active products with optional filters.
Returns full product detail including images, videos, SEO meta, and JSON-LD schemas.

Full-text search via Meilisearch (Scout). Falls back to Eloquent LIKE
queries when SCOUT_DRIVER=null or Meilisearch is unreachable.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/cart
Return the current cart. Creates one if none exists.

DELETE /api/v1/cart
Remove all items from the cart.

POST /api/v1/cart/items
Add a product to the cart. Increments quantity if already present.

PUT /api/v1/cart/items/{cartItem}
Set an item's quantity to an exact value.

DELETE /api/v1/cart/items/{cartItem}
Remove a single item from the cart.

POST /api/v1/cart/merge  [auth:sanctum]
Merge guest cart into the authenticated user's cart.

GET /api/v1/orders
Paginated order history for the authenticated user.

POST /api/v1/orders
Place a new order from the current cart.

GET /api/v1/orders/{order}
Single order detail. Policy ensures user owns the order.

PATCH /api/v1/orders/{order}/cancel
Cancel a pending order. Policy ensures user owns the order.
